comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber, versus tip a rocker and rotate an eccentric counterweight past an obstructing post so it settles on a new stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires fine tool engagement, screw/collar adjustment, reacquisition, and iterative testing; record requires simultaneous beam tipping and counterweight rotation against gravity and obstruction.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two repeatable bounded carriage stops without overload or setting drift. Record requires the counterweight to clear the post and the released rocker to settle on the opposite stop; exact angular thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: The rocker task tests bimanual state-dependent mechanism reconfiguration, not tool-mediated adjustment followed by measured dynamic commissioning. Its omitted angular rubric does not obscure the meaningful distinction.
